title: Atendente de Relacionamento ao Cliente (Atuar no Segmento Imobiliário)
description:
Descrição da empresa

Somos um dos maiores fundos de investimentos imobiliários do país. Nosso principal objetivo é desenvolver projetos imobiliários de qualidade. Possuímos uma equipe de especialistas que trabalha de forma ativa com uma rede qualificada de parceiros para realizar, com excelência, projetos diferenciados. Mais de 25 anos em gestão de investimentos com retornos consistentes, foco na preservação de patrimônio e visão de longo prazo.

Descrição da Vaga

Atender o cliente de forma clara, objetiva e resolutiva com a brevidade que o assunto requer. Prestar esclarecimentos e orientações gerais aos clientes sobre contratos e todas as etapas de processos de relacionamento com o cliente, incluindo atualização de dados cadastrais, emissão de boletos, extratos e demonstrativos de valores pagos.

  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre produtos e serviços, prestando informações claras e precisas;
  • Registrar atendimentos, solicitações e reclamações nos sistemas internos;
  • Acompanhar demandas até a resolução, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a satisfação do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria no atendimento e sugerir soluções;
  • Atuar em parceria com outras áreas para solucionar demandas mais complexas.

Pré-Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Perfil empático, proativo e orientado à solução;
  • Organização e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas;
  • Conhecimento básico em informática e sistemas de atendimento;
  • Conhecimento financeiro (juros compostos, correção monetária, sistema de amortização).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com CRM ou ferramentas de atendimento;
  • Vivência em empresas de serviços, call center ou relacionamento com clientes;
  • Atuação em relacionamento com o cliente, com foco em bom atendimento e experiência do cliente (CX).
  • Conhecimento básico de métricas de satisfação, como NPS e CSAT.

Idiomas

Inglês - Nível Intermediário

Outros Requisitos

  • Falar e escrever muito bem.
  • Tom de voz claro.
  • Capacidade de se relacionar bem internamente e externamente com resiliência.
  • Competências: Colaborador, produtividade, iniciativa e eficácia.
  • Capacidade de adaptabilidade, gostar de mudanças, desafios e ter equilíbrio emocional.

  • Liderar equipes de manutenção e operadores, promovendo disciplina, organização e padrão técnico.
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas sobre recuperação, substituição ou desmobilização de ativos.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança, operação e conservação dos equipamentos.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Experiência comprovada em frota e mecanização agrícola.

  • Experiência em gestão de manutenção com baixo orçamento e restrição de recursos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experiência com SAP Business One será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil técnico, pragmático, organizado e orientado a solução.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes exigentes, com pressão por resultado e eficiência.
  • Boa comunicação, liderança prática e responsabilidade operacional.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em fazenda.

  • Diagnosticar e propor soluções técnicas: Entender a fundo as necessidades dos clientes para desenhar e apresentar soluções completas e integradas em nosso portfólio (segurança eletrônica, redes, comunicação e energia), realizando demonstrações e prestando consultoria especializada.

  • Elaborar e negociar propostas de valor: Criar propostas comerciais e orçamentos detalhados e tecnicamente consistentes, negociando termos que gerem valor para o cliente e para a SDE, e otimizando o processo de vendas.

  • Representar a SDE como referência técnica: Fortalecer a imagem da SDE em eventos do setor e assegurar a satisfação do cliente no pós-venda, buscando oportunidades de cross‑selling e up‑selling.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

    • Segurança Eletrônica: CFTV (analógico/IP), controle de acesso (biometria, RFID), alarmes, sistemas de monitoramento.
    • Redes e Comunicação: Redes estruturadas (cabeamento, switches, roteadores), Wi‑Fi, PABX IP.
    • Energia: Noções de energia solar fotovoltaica, no‑breaks, estabilizadores, sistemas de alimentação ininterrupta.
  • Habilidade para interpretar projetos técnicos e diagramas.
  • Experiência com CRM ou ferramentas de gestão de vendas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

Soft Skills

  • Curiosidade e Aprendizagem Contínua: Paixão por tecnologia e por se manter atualizado em um mercado dinâmico.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Habilidade para identificar problemas, analisar dados e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Comunicação Assertiva e Didática: Capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
  • Proatividade e Autonomia: Iniciativa para buscar novas oportunidades e gerenciar sua carteira de forma independente.
  • Orientação para Resultados e Foco no Cliente: Impulso para superar metas, sempre com o cliente no centro das decisões.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Para lidar com desafios, negociações e construir relacionamentos.

Hard Skills Complementares

  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo ou em andamento em cursos como Engenharia (Elétrica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Controle e Automação), Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou áreas afins.

Experiência Profissional

description:
Visão Geral

PRIO busca Engenheiro(a) de Poços Sênior para integrar a área de Engenharia de Poços, atuando de forma estratégica e técnica no planejamento, execução e otimização de poços offshore no Brasil, abrangendo poços subsea e surface. Este(a) profissional será responsável pelo ciclo completo do poço, desde as fases de conceito e planejamento até a execução, acompanhamento operacional e pós-poço, assegurando segurança, integridade, eficiência operacional e aderência a custos e cronogramas, em alinhamento com padrões corporativos e regulatórios.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, projetar e revisar programas de perfuração, completação e intervenção de poços subsea e surface, considerando requisitos técnicos, operacionais, econômicos e de HSE.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento técnico da execução offshore, suportando operações de perfuração, revestimento, cimentação, completação e testes, garantindo conformidade com o programa aprovado.
  • Avaliar riscos operacionais (well integrity, controle de poço, stuck pipe, perdas, estabilidade do poço) e implementar estratégias de mitigação alinhadas às melhores práticas da indústria.
  • Interface técnica com equipes de Operações, Subsea, Geologia, Reservatórios, SMS, Suprimentos e fornecedores de serviços (drilling contractors, service companies).
  • Liderar ou apoiar análises técnicas, revisões de projeto (DWOPs, peer reviews), AARs (After Action Reviews) e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Suportar processos de contratação e gestão de fornecedores, incluindo definição de escopo técnico, avaliação de propostas, acompanhamento de desempenho e controle de custos.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de processos, especificações técnicas, lições aprendidas e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) de poços.
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos regulatórios locais (ANP, IBAMA, Marinha) e padrões internos de governança e segurança de poços.

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (Petróleo, Mecânica, Química, Civil).
  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Poços offshore no Brasil, com vivência comprovada em campanhas de perfuração em águas profundas e ultraprofundas.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em projetos de poços, controle de poço, integridade de poços e gestão de riscos.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com múltiplas disciplinas e liderar discussões técnicas complexas.
  • Boa comunicação, organização, pensamento analítico e habilidade para tomada de decisão em ambientes operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em análise de desempenho operacional, AFE, estimativas de custo e acompanhamento de budget de poços.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e softwares de engenharia de poços (ex.: WellPlan, Wellcat, DrillPlan, Landmark, Drillbench ou similares).

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Em seguida, a equipe de RH marcará um papo para aprofundar suas experiências, alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e valores da PRIO. O papo também abordará a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e dúvidas.

Dicas: durante a conversa, estaremos interessados em experiências que você vivenciou, com contextos, responsabilidades, ações e resultados, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO.

Depois, entraremos em aspectos mais técnicos, como um case ou entrevista com o gestor da vaga. Ao final, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da área para a decisão final.

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the Project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to Get Started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: Can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: Can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: What’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, "what could go wrong")
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Mas somos incansáveis e sabemos que há muito a ser feito, para isso, estamos investindo em fortalecer ainda mais o nosso ecossistema de serviços, produtos e contratação de gente melhor que a gente para continuar alcançando voos ainda mais altos e resultados expressivos.

About The Role

As a Financial Reporting Analyst at VTEX, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of consolidated financial reporting. You will support and lead various financial reporting processes, engage in technical accounting matters, and collaborate on projects that enhance efficiencies and decision-making within the organization. This position provides an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast‑paced environment and make a significant impact on VTEX's financial reporting standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes, ensuring compliance with Group accounting policies and standards.
  • Assist with month‑end close procedures, including comprehensive analysis of variances and account reconciliations.
  • Manage technical accounting matters, ensuring alignment with financial reporting accounting standards (USGAAP) and VTEX’s accounting policies.
  • Calculate intercompany costs, monitor mismatches, and oversee transactions between companies such as debt, asset transfers, and cost allocations.
  • Support external and internal audits by providing timely and accurate responses to audit queries and maintaining complete documentation.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve accounting processes and reporting, driving efficiency and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on USGAAP reporting developments and implement changes as required.
  • Participate in special projects, such as ERP implementations and other financial transformation initiatives.
  • Explain variations in financial results and changes occurring during reporting periods.

About The Team

The Consolidation and Financial Reporting team is responsible for consolidating the financial results of VTEX subsidiaries and preparing internal and external financial statements in compliance with USGAAP and SEC requirements. The team collaborates closely with Controllership, Investor Relations, and FP&A, ensuring timely and accurate financial information. At VTEX, you will thrive in a proactive environment where results are celebrated and innovation is encouraged. You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that drive business growth and innovation. You will join a team that values excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. This role offers a chance to make a tangible impact while growing your career in a supportive and dynamic environment.

  • 2+ years of experience in Big 4/public accounting or mid‑to‑large public/global companies.
  • Strong knowledge of USGAAP, BRGAAP, and financial reporting standards, including group consolidation and foreign exchange.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., FCCS, Narrative, PBCS) and intercompany transactions.
  • Strong analytical and systemic thinking to design simple solutions for complex problems.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high‑quality results.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills in English; Portuguese proficiency is a plus.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and self‑motivated with strong organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders and work collaboratively in a flat organizational structure.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the enterprise digital commerce platform where global brands and retailers run their world of commerce. VTEX is trusted by more than 2,400 customers, such as AbInbev, Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola and Whirlpool, with over 3,200 active online stores across 38 countries*.

Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high‑tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,400 employees scattered across 18 locations in 12 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. The Company You’ll Join Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your Core Responsibilities Will Include

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.
  • Quality & Timeliness: Ensure all data is extracted in a timely manner and meets our high standards for data quality.
  • Customer Support: Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your segment services.
  • Active Engagement: Proactively follow up with clients during each quarterly data campaign, providing clear tracking of what data is complete and ready for client review.
  • Real-time Interaction: Engage with clients in real-time via phone or Zoom to resolve issues and guide them through their data.
  • Process Improvement: Keep detailed documentation of client interactions to identify trends and drive operational and process improvements for the data ops team and the product teams.
  • Project Management: Treat every data campaign as a project, ensuring all stakeholders are updated on progress and milestones.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert in private markets data, including financial metrics and KPIs.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Analytical Skills: Knowledge of financial statements and common financial concepts with a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client Service: Care deeply and genuinely about client services; you exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and platforms quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Engenharia de Tracking e Implementação

  • Liderar Implementações: Conduzir e supervisionar o ciclo completo de projetos de tracking, trabalhando em parceria com os times de Engenharia e Tecnologia
  • Tradução Técnica: Atuar como ponte entre Marketing (Paid Media, CRM, SEO, etc.) e Tecnologia, traduzindo objetivos de negócio e KPIs em requisitos técnicos detalhados (plano de medição)

You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a corrosion engineer to join the Southern Area Asset Integrity Division (SAAID) of SAOP Technical Support Department.

SAAID is responsible for providing effective and proactive corrosion management support to safeguard assets while adopting best industry practices and cutting-edge technologies.

Your primary role is to perform integrity and corrosion analysis studies to assess current challenges and develop a mitigation plan by implementing cost effective solutions and deployment of advanced and proven technologies to prevent or significantly reduce the impact of corrosion. This is to be supported with benchmarking and implementation of strategies that will enhance the long‑term reliability and asset efficiency of our assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform periodical analytical study of corrosion assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs
  • Research and Deploy emerging Technologies related to corrosion mitigation and non‑metallic deployment.
  • Act as expert corrosion and asset integrity management resource for corrosion risk assessment and mitigation.
  • Develop Pipeline Integrity Plans (PIP) aligned with the organization integrity performance objectives, assigning responsibilities, and timeframes for the responsible stakeholder.
  • Develop annual condition assessment schedule in line with the PIP recommendations.
  • Review PIP trends and initiate detailed engineering studies accordingly (e.g. increase in internal corrosion features, encroachment to pipelines, low quality of ILI reports, failure investigations, etc.)
  • Facilitate the investigation of corrosion failure and deploy lesson learned from the root cause analysis to the system to avoid reoccurrence.
  • Perform periodical analytical study of assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs.
  • Evaluate the QA findings and perform periodical analytical study of assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs.
  • Provide consultation on specialized area related to corrosion control.
  • Perform integrity and corrosion analysis studies to assess current challenges.
  • Monitor the corrosion parameters such PH, O2, bacteria, residual of biocide chemical, and take corrective actions accordingly.
  • Review the inspection data and make corrosion control recommendations/reports accordingly.
  • Review laboratory data/parameters and issue the recommendations accordingly.
  • Apply corrosion monitoring system/program to ensure the integrity & reliability of the plant assets.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in corrosion Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have 15 years‑experience in corrosion engineering, including at least three years as senior corrosion engineer.
  • Must have a comprehensive knowledge of corrosion principles, including electrochemistry, material properties, corrosion mechanisms, and corrosion prevention methods.
  • Should also have sufficient background in various laboratory and field‑testing techniques used to assess corrosion behavior, such as accelerated corrosion testing, electrochemical corrosion monitoring, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Familiarity with corrosion prevention and control strategies, including material selection, protective coatings, cathodic protection, corrosion inhibitors, and corrosion monitoring systems is a requirement.
  • Understanding of industry standards and codes related to corrosion, such as National Association of Corrosion Engineers (NACE), American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) International standards, and API (American Petroleum Institute) standards.
  • Practical experience through entry‑level positions or corrosion engineering roles in industries such as oil and gas, aerospace, chemical processing, marine, or infrastructure.
  • Demonstrate effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness about the latest advancements in corrosion science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.

Working environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector‑specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Overview

Cyrex, a Magic Media company, is a media and tech start-up powered by creativity and innovation. This is a full-time position. The role requires strong low-level technical skills, such as C++ programming, working with network protocols, or reverse engineering. If your experience is mainly in web hacking, you should instead apply for the on-demand penetration testing position, which focuses more on web security.

Responsibilities

  • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games
  • Reverse engineer game binaries and network protocols to identify vulnerabilities
  • Bypass client-side protections (SSL pinning, anti-cheat, packing/obfuscation)
  • Develop and maintain internal tools and PoCs (C++, Python)

Requirements

  • 5+ years in penetration testing, reverse engineering or security research
  • Strong modern C++ and Python experience

  • Minimal RE capability: read disassembly when needed; use IDA/Ghidra and x64dbg/WinDbg/LLDB to support testing (deep reversing not required)
  • Basic web hacking knowledge

Working knowledge

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp

Benefits

  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects
  • The chance to work closely with a team of like-minded creative professionals in a fast-paced, multicultural environment on a variety of gaming projects
  • A competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities

If this sounds interesting to you and you\'d like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we\'d love to hear from you.

title: Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Descrição da vaga

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.

Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.

O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.

Porque na Norsul, pertender é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuação em embarcações, realizando toda a gestão de segurança dos navios;

  • Promover inspeções nos navios identificando condições perigosas;

  • Preparar programas de treinamento sobre segurança do trabalho;
  • Analisar as ocorrências de Acidente de Trabalho;
  • Efetuar controle das informações referentes aos certificados para utilização dos EPIs;
  • Revisão e análise dos procedimentos internos relacionados à segurança do trabalho;
  • Prestar apoio à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Técnico de Segurança, com registro ativo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (rotina de viagens para visitas às embarcações);
  • Experiência no segmento de navegação / offshore será considerado um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde e odonto
  • Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)

  • Shiatsu
  • Ticket alimentação/refeição
  • Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day off de aniversário

Fazer parte

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

Se esse jeito de trabalhar faz sentido pra você, o próximo embarque pode ser o seu!

Buscamos um profissional de Infraestrutura de TI, capaz de administrar e evoluir ambientes on-premises e em nuvem, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos serviços, com sólida base em Windows, Linux, redes, virtualização e segurança, além de interesse em automação, padronização e boas práticas, boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa apoiando a modernização contínua da infraestrutura e o crescimento do negócio.

Atribuições principais:

  • Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
  • Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
  • Criar políticas de backup e segurança;

  • Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
  • Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
  • Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
  • Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.

Requisitos:

  • Administração de ambientes Windows Server, incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat), com experiência em gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
  • Domínio de protocolos de rede, incluindo TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
  • Conhecimento em hardware de rede, com configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
  • Experiência na configuração e suporte a serviços de rede, como VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, incluindo gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
  • Conhecimento em virtualização, utilizando ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
  • Experiência em storage, com gerenciamento de ambientes NAS e SAN, protocolos iSCSI e Fibre Channel, além da gestão de LUNs.
  • Configuração e administração de firewalls, como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
  • Implementação e gestão de rotinas de backup, políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes, utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento básico em Infrastructure as Code (IaC), com utilização de ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible.
  • Noções de containers, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script, como PowerShell ou Python, para automação de tarefas rotineiras.

Híbrido no Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Realizar manutenção, operação e melhorias em sistemas elétricos e automatizados de máquinas industriais como injetoras, sopradoras, rotuladoras e moinhos, assegurando o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficiente das linhas de produção, em conformidade com normas técnicas e regulatórias (GMP, ANVISA, NR‑10, NR‑12).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em sistemas elétricos e de automação de máquinas injetoras, sopradoras, rotuladoras e moinhos.
  • Programar e ajustar CLPs, IHMs e sistemas supervisórios, garantindo a operação eficiente e segura dos equipamentos.
  • Realizar diagnósticos de falhas elétricas e de automação, propondo soluções técnicas rápidas e eficazes.
  • Efetuar calibração e testes de sensores, atuadores, inversores de frequência e sistemas de controle.
  • Participar da instalação e comissionamento de novos equipamentos, assegurando conformidade com os padrões técnicos e regulatórios.
  • Documentar todas as intervenções técnicas, mantendo registros atualizados conforme exigências da ANVISA e boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de melhoria contínua, eficiência energética e automação de processos.
  • Cumprir rigorosamente normas de segurança e qualidade, como NR‑10, NR‑12, e protocolos internos da indústria farmacêutica.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Formação técnica em Eletrotécnica, Automação Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com máquinas injetoras, sopradoras, rotuladoras e moinhos.
  • Conhecimento em leitura de diagramas elétricos, pneumáticos e de automação.
  • Experiência em automação será considerado um diferencial.
  • Domínio em programação de CLPs (ex: Siemens, Allen‑Bradley), redes industriais (Profibus, Ethernet/IP) e sistemas SCADA.
  • Familiaridade com normas GMP, ANVISA e segurança elétrica.
  • Perfil proativo, analítico e com boa comunicação para atuação em equipe.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos ou regime de plantão.

description:
Overview

A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona. Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma como é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente. Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Advogado e a missão dessa posição é atuar na gestão jurídica da empresa, com foco em contratos, acompanhamento de escritórios parceiros e controle dos processos administrativos e judiciais. A posição exige visão de negócio, boa comunicação com áreas internas e capacidade de reduzir custos jurídicos externos por meio de análises e soluções internas.

Conhecimento prático de LGPD.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos de fornecedores, prestadores de serviço e obras (instalação e manutenção de lojas), assegurando conformidade legal e mitigação de riscos;
  • Gestão de riscos: Analisar cláusulas críticas de LGPD, rescisão, multas e confidencialidade, garantindo a segurança jurídica nas negociações;
  • Interface com escritórios externos: Atuar como ponto focal entre a empresa e os escritórios jurídicos nas áreas societária, trabalhista, tributária e civil;
  • Controle administrativo: Organizar e controlar todos os assuntos jurídicos, garantindo rastreabilidade e histórico completo;
  • Gestão de marcas e ativos fixos: Acompanhar processos de renovação de marcas, patentes e registros relacionados aos ativos fixos da empresa;
  • Redução de custos jurídicos: Realizar análises e pareceres internos em casos e contratos de menor complexidade, evitando gastos desnecessários com escritórios externos;
  • Gestão financeira jurídica: Controlar despesas com escritórios terceirizados, validar faturas, aprovar pagamentos e manter relatórios de custos mensais por vertical;
  • Fechamento contábil e acompanhamento judicial: Consolidar mensalmente o status dos processos judiciais e administrativos, enviando relatórios de provisões e contabilizações à controladoria.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Direito com OAB ativa;
  • Experiência prévia em contratos comerciais, direito empresarial e contencioso cível/trabalhista;
  • Vivência com contratos de obras e prestação de serviços;
  • Conhecimento prático de LGPD;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e interface com múltiplas áreas internas;
  • Excel e controle de planilhas (para gestão de contratos, processos e despesas).

Soft Skills

  • Perfil analítico e pensamento estratégico;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva com diferentes áreas;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e gestão de prazos;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso crítico;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas demandas;

Requisitos desejáveis

title: Graduate HR Generalist - AMER
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

Location

This role will be based remotely in the AMER region.

Responsibilities

  • Provide HR support by answering team members’ questions and responding to requests regarding their employment and contracts, escalating when necessary. Requests may include information about the new starter process and onboarding, questions regarding global benefits, employment verifications, and other general inquiries.
  • Maintain our HRIS, ensuring a high degree of accuracy and timeliness in processing all team member changes and new joiners.
  • Own global projects (e.g., engagement, training or culture initiatives).
  • Partner with managers and employees, supporting HR processes and driving the people strategy for your areas of responsibility.
  • Work as a truly global partner to colleagues, especially leads, managers and executives.
  • Process new hires, including country‑specific onboarding documentation, creation of files, systems set‑up, and coordination of introductory reviews.
  • Provide support to employees for the enrollment and processing of benefits and the payroll process, ensuring monthly data is provided on time and is accurate.
  • Liaise with payroll to guarantee smooth salary payments.
  • Create purchase orders for internal departments.
  • Conduct regular audits of employment files and systems to ensure they are up‑to‑date, accurate, and GDPR compliant.
  • Continuously work to improve our processes, spotting areas where we can enhance the function.

What We Are Looking For

  • Track record of exceptional achievement from high school and graduate studies.
  • Internship experience working in an HR/People team is beneficial, preferably in the technology industry.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize complex workloads, manage time effectively and work well under pressure.
  • Self‑motivated and results‑oriented with a clear focus on accuracy.
  • High level of honesty, integrity, and ability to handle confidential data.
  • Flexible attitude and easily adaptable to change.
  • Willingness to take the initiative and provide suggestions and ideas to contribute to the success of the role/team.
  • Ambitious to grow your career within HR.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.
  • Fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese a plus.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is a equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data‑driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team‑first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail‑oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value‑selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

title: Legacy Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Strategy & Planning

Location

Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGOs and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your Profile

Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations

  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.

Legacy Development

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organising, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post‑event reporting.

Communication & Stakeholder Relations

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.

Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience

  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Core
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring a technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.

This is an opportunity for a technical leader passionate about open‑source software, Linux, containers, security, and the developer experience, to shape the future of Linux from the smallest systems up to desktops. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next‑generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an engineering manager, you’ll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC‑V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap, and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

  • Building and leading a distributed team of engineers through hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development
  • Demonstrating sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Coaching and mentoring team members with hands‑on career development
  • Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organization

What we are looking for in you

  • Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development
  • Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell
  • A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core
  • Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC‑V
  • Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre o Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Planejar, implementar e monitorar a distribuição de medicamentos, produtos e materiais nas diversas unidades do hospital, orientando sobre dados técnicos, tais como: dosagem, fórmula farmacêutica, composição química, substitutos etc; produzir; executar a guardar e controlar a distribuição de medicamentos; realizar controle diário dos estoques.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde.

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Escala: 12H trabalhadas x 60H de descanso
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Quality Data Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Introduction

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This position is for talented and experienced Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, volume, and accuracy of data across on‑prem and cloud environments. You will validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using IDMC, collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, results, and findings in a structured and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Apply IDMC coding skills, including creating end‑to‑end mappings with Filters, Routers, and Joiners.
  • Work with JSON structures, filters, and parsers to validate and transform data.
  • Apply basic Java knowledge to support custom code requirements.
  • Use Python to read and process data from various file formats, leveraging functions and libraries such as Pandas.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong background in software product development and delivery.
  • Solid expertise in SQL for data validation and transformation.
  • Proven ability to design and execute data test plans, scenarios, and cases, with clear documentation of results.
  • Strong knowledge of Informatica IDMC or related data management tools.
  • Experience with Azure Cloud technologies such as ADF and PySpark.
  • Proficiency in Python and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Ability to interpret and create System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams.
  • Background in Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

Minimum Position Qualifications / Education Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or related information technology field from an accredited institution or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of software product development and delivery experience.
  • 5+ years of SQL experience.

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical is a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business. This role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large, complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.

You will be managing projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

Responsibilities

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What we are looking for in you

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação

Laudo médico válido e carimbado por médico especialista.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior/Lead Full-Stack Engineer, you will help build a financial intelligence platform designed for AI consumption, turning complex data into actionable insights. This is a full-time role starting with a focused 6‑month project, offering strong autonomy and fast execution in a product‑driven environment. You will act as a hands‑on utility player, working across frontend, backend, integrations, and light architecture while shaping a cohesive, customer‑ready system. Successful delivery opens the opportunity to continue on other impactful projects.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the implementation and integration of existing product components, including AI usage dashboards and advisor insights;
  • Design and build backend functionality to support billing rules, chargeback logic, and ROI calculation for AI usage;
  • Integrate external billing data sources, starting with cloud billing systems;
  • Build and evolve APIs and data pipelines that translate raw billing data into usable financial insights;
  • Implement frontend functionality to surface metrics, dashboards, and data‑heavy UI views clearly and pragmatically;
  • Make sound architectural decisions at a medium level of complexity, prioritizing maintainability and speed;
  • Collaborate closely with product stakeholders, operating with minimal process overhead;
  • Ensure smooth deployment and delivery workflows using Vercel;
  • Contribute to overall product cohesion by connecting disparate parts into a single, usable experience;
  • Work full‑time on a 6‑month project, with the opportunity to continue on other projects afterward.

MUST HAVES

  • 4+ years of experience and strong full‑stack background with proven ability to move across frontend, backend, and integrations;
  • Solid experience with Python and Node.js in production environments;
  • Experience designing and working with PostgreSQL schemas and data models ;
  • Direct experience integrating cloud billing systems or similar cost and usage APIs ;
  • Experience building frontend applications deployed via Vercel (React or similar frameworks);
  • Strong experience consuming and integrating third‑party APIs, especially billing or usage‑based systems;
  • Demonstrated ability to work with incomplete requirements and turn them into working solutions;
  • Comfortable operating in early‑stage product environments with limited structure;
  • Professional working proficiency in English;
  • Experience integrating frontend tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar);
  • Familiarity with observability and usage tracking concepts (e.g., OpenTelemetry or similar telemetry systems);
  • Experience building or consuming SDKs.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with PHP;
  • Experience building financial, billing, or cost‑allocation systems;
  • Familiarity with AI usage metrics, token‑based billing, or ROI tracking models;
  • Experience working on dashboards, tables, filters, and data‑dense UI patterns;
  • Prior startup or founder‑led product experience;
  • Exposure to AI tooling workflows.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.
